rows.name: San Luis Valley-Poncha 230 kV Line Project
rows.quote: This project consists of a new 230 kV transmission line from the existing San Luis Valley Substation to the existing Poncha Substation. This project is under re-evaluation through sub-regional planning groups and the projected in-service date for this project is TBD.

rows.name: Burlington – Lamar 230 kV Line
rows.quote: Burlington – Lamar 230 kV Line (2022 Waiver Granted) This project consists of a new 230 kV transmission line from the existing Burlington Substation to the existing Lamar (Tri-State) Substation.

rows.name: Boone – Huckleberry 230 kV Line
rows.quote: Boone – Huckleberry 230 kV Line (2022 Waiver Granted) This project consists of a new 230 kV transmission line from the existing Boone Substation to a new Huckleberry Substation, which will sectionalize the existing Comanche – Walsenburg 230 kV line near Comanche Substation.
rows.status_raw: final stages of the substation construction process have begun

rows.name: Badger Creek – Big Sandy 230 kV Line
rows.quote: Badger Creek – Big Sandy 230 kV Line (2022 Waiver Granted) This project consists of a new 230 kV transmission line from the existing Big Sandy Substation to a new Badger Creek Substation, which will sectionalize the existing Henry Lake – Story 230 kV line.

rows.name: Big Sandy – Burlington 230 kV Line Uprate
rows.quote: Big Sandy – Burlington 230 kV Line Uprate (2022 Waiver Granted) This project consists of structure replacements and/or modifications along the existing Big Sandy – Windtalker – Landsman Creek – Burlington 230 kV line to improve the line rating.

rows.name: Crosspoint 230 kV Substation
rows.quote: Crosspoint 230 kV Substation (2023 Waiver Granted) This project consists of a new 230 kV Crosspoint Substation, which will sectionalize the existing Lincoln – Midway 230 kV line.

rows.name: Milk Creek 345 kV Substation
rows.quote: Milk Creek 345 kV Substation (2024 Waiver Granted) This project consists of a new 345 kV Milk Substation, which will sectionalize the existing Craig – Meeker 345 kV line. This project is needed to interconnect a 145 MW generator, and is not expected to have significant impact to the reliability of the WECC interconnected system. This substation went into service August 2025

rows.name: Boone – Lamar 230 kV Reconductor
rows.quote: Boone – Lamar 230 kV Reconductor (2025 Waiver Granted) This project consists of replacing the Boone – Lamar 230 kV transmission line SD conductor with equivalently sized ACSR conductor.

rows.name: Pegs – Ambrosia 230 kV Line Upgrade
rows.quote: Project Description: Perform two structure replacements on the PEGS (Escalante) – Ambrosia 230 kV Line to improve its Maximum Operating Temperature from 50°C to 100°C. The line is constructed with 1590 kcmil ACSR “Falcon” conductor. Voltage Class: 230 kV Facility Rating: 446 MVA (terminal limited) Location: Western New Mexico, McKinley county
